requirement: Authentication BlacklistToken entity initialization: a revoked token stores the SHA-256 hash and revocation reason, optionally carries the original expiration date, and receives the ServiceDefaults UUID v7 identifier and audit defaults.

preconditions.text: A BlacklistToken is constructed with HashToken and Reason

returns.text: ExpirationDate preserves the supplied value and defaults to null when omitted
A non-empty UUID v7 id plus UTC audit timestamps and not-soft-deleted defaults

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the revoked-token entity initializes successfully
